searchText: I also received a letter of rejection, but I am grateful to be able to participate in this project in a permissionless manner to anyone who gets rejected: back when MolochDAO decided to alleviate Ethereum's privacy problem, instead of picking the 🌪️ Cash team, it picked someone else. That group failed, and 🌪️ went and rage built 🌪️ Cash. I realize this is a sensitive subject due to the feds current inquisition against privacy but the point is that if you can can do the work, you'll likely get the recognition. filtering is hard <@350513362423250945> That's an interesting story. Thanks for sharing We'll 100% get applicants wrong - there are sooo many, and a large % are "good or better" - we then rely on various imperfect signals to try and triage through them. We're aware of that, and hope that our design of the program allows people to prove us wrong - like they have in previous batches 😄
